budgets.budget_measure: length of canonical JSON bytes delivered to the fresh consumer, including codec envelope and excluding causal receipts
budgets.operation_unit: one decoded-event visit, candidate-mask test, parity evaluation, GF(2) row xor, or comparison

online_positive_references.state_schema: canonical {schema_version:1, models:[decimal mask integers in first-discovery order], basis:[[decimal row mask, outcome bit] in descending-pivot reduced-row-echelon order]}; every pivot is eliminated from every other row and the basis covers only the current episode
online_positive_references.prediction: retain cached models satisfying every current-episode equation; if none remain, use every weight-4-through-8 mask satisfying them; predict strict majority parity and use zero on a tie
online_positive_references.update: treat the basis as empty for an episode-start prediction; clear the old basis only when that released outcome is appended, reduce the new equation canonically, fail on inconsistency, and append a uniquely solved mask once

online_positive_references.state_schema: canonical {schema_version, event_count, payload_base64}; append-only 14-bit rows ordered episode_start then 12 public feature bits then released outcome, right-zero-padded only in the final byte
online_positive_references.prediction: validate RFC 4648 base64 and zero padding, replay the complete prefix from empty state, and keep solved masks in first-discovery order; treat the current basis as empty when the current query marks episode start; retain distinct solved prior masks satisfying every current-episode equation; if none remain, use all 4096 masks satisfying them; predict strict majority parity and use zero on a tie
online_positive_references.update: append exactly one 14-bit row only after its prediction and outcome are bound; persist no derived model or cache outside the delivered log projection

required_nonlearning_controls.state: fresh empty state at every encounter
the byte-identical initial seed projection at every encounter

required_nonlearning_controls.prediction: counterfactual predictions under the smallest integer mask among weight-4-through-8 masks with minimum complete-stream error
required_nonlearning_controls.state: offline noncausal lower-bound benchmark that is authority-ineligible as a positive lineage

adaptive_comparators.state: canonical {schema_version:1, events:[{public_query: exact released query, outcome: released bit}]}; after append, discard the oldest complete rows until the canonical projection is at most 2048 bytes
adaptive_comparators.prediction: replay retained episode segments only, keep any uniquely solved retained masks consistent with the current retained episode, otherwise use eligible masks consistent with that episode, and use strict-majority parity with tie zero

adaptive_comparators.state: the same bounded lossless epistemic rows available to the positive log lineage
adaptive_comparators.prediction: outcome of minimum-Hamming-distance prior feature, most-recent then smallest-feature tie break, or zero when empty

adaptive_comparator_disposition: report exact trajectories and authority checks; their performance does not decide longitudinal promotion and beating them would be an additional inductive-efficiency claim

causal_loss.mutation: retain scored outcomes in world receipts but replace every updater delivery with an explicit no-op
deliver the prior encounter outcome as the current updater label, using zero at encounter zero, in an explicitly intervention-typed lineage
compute and receipt each valid post-state but deliver the exact pre-state projection to the next consumer
emit a receipted no-op post-state and deliver its unchanged canonical projection
substitute a valid sibling projection and require fail-closed rejection before scoring it as a positive lineage

identity_placebo.rule: two independently labeled immutable-seed lineages must remain byte- and score-identical

recurrence.mutation: replace each episode-start inherited state with the exact initial projection before prediction

scoring.recovery_definition: zero-based earliest episode offset r at most dwell-8 for which every prediction from r through episode end is correct; dwell if absent
scoring.paired_win_requirement: both references beat all four required nonlearning controls in all 8 streams
scoring.causal_intervention_rule: A = max(0, immutable_seed_errors - intervention_errors); require 10 * A <= L

metamorphic_anchors: trace-level simultaneous prediction-and-outcome label complement without learner rerun
task-level case-order reversal with isolated state
